summary: The init-and-properties group covers 183 manifest rows (181 regular files, 2 symlinks) across five partitions (odm_a 24, product_a 2, system_a 80, system_ext_a 31, vendor_a 46). It contains the init executable and its two symlinks, the main system init script with zygote and USB variants, 170 .rc files defining 191 services and 371 on-triggers, vendor init scripts for the anorak SoC and eureka device, three vendor shell helpers, two fstab files, two ueventd.rc rule files, and five build.prop files holding 395 distinct property keys. Boot flow as declared by the files: the init binary reads /system/etc/init/hw/init.rc, which imports /init.environ.rc, the USB scripts, /vendor/etc/init/hw/init.${ro.hardware}.rc (init.eureka.rc, which imports init.anorak.rc) and /system/etc/init/hw/init.${ro.zygote}.rc (init.zygote64_stub32.rc, selected by ro.zygote=zygote64_stub32 in the vendor build.prop). The fstab selected by ro.hardware is /vendor/etc/fstab.eureka, loaded by mount_all in init.anorak.rc. The ro.hardware value itself is not in any build.prop of this group.

claims.claim: The init binary exports 124 defined dynamic symbols and imports 534 undefined ones. The binary exports no stable command-line interface through these symbols.
claims.label: verified
claims.evidence: readelf --dyn-syms -W init | awk '$7!="UND" && NR>3' | wc -l -> 124; awk '$7=="UND" && NR>3' -> 534. Undefined: __system_property_find, __system_property_set, __system_property_foreach, selinux_android_restorecon, selinux_check_access, selinux_set_callback, __android_log_write
claims.reason: Command: readelf --dyn-syms -W init | grep -E '^ +[0-9]+:' -> 658 rows, matching the header 'contains 658 entries'. awk '$7!="UND"' -> 124 defined (claim matches). awk '$7=="UND"' -> 534, but this includes entry 0, the reserved null symbol (Ndx UND, no name; awk 'NF<8' -> 1 row). Excluding entry 0 gives 533 named undefined symbols. Defined names include _ZN7android6fs_mgr14GetBootDevicesEv and _Z28fs_mgr_parse_proc_bootconfig...; undefined names include __system_property_find, __system_property_set, __system_property_foreach, selinux_android_restorecon, selinux_check_access, selinux_set_callback, __android_log_write. gaps: ro.hardware is not set in any build.prop in this group and is not present in the mounted tree; the eureka selection of init.eureka.rc and fstab.eureka is inferred from file names. Its source (kernel command line or bootloader) was not examined.

Precedence when the same property key is set in several build.prop files (persist.sys.usb.config, dalvik.vm.heap*, ro.control_privapp_permissions) was not determined; the init loader logic is not in the tree and the binary was not disassembled.

The built-in command table and the ueventd-versus-init mode selection were checked only by exact-string presence in the init binary; no disassembly or control-flow analysis was done. verity_load_state and rm are absent as standalone strings.
The init binary's version or build banner string was not identified.
The first-stage ramdisk init.rc (first_stage_ramdisk) and the boot image were not in this group; only the system and vendor copies were examined.

Service binaries named by the rc files (under /vendor/bin, /system/bin, /system_ext/bin, /product/bin, /odm/bin) belong to other subsystems and were not inspected; only what the scripts declare is recorded.

Full text was not read line by line for the larger scripts: init.rc (55,112 bytes), atrace.rc (24,276), init.anorak.rc (18,409 read in part), init.anorak.cgroup.rc (9,637), init.anorak.usb.rc (8,663), init.usb.configfs.rc (7,690), wifi.rc (5,715), perfetto.rc (4,858). Their structure was taken from service, trigger, import and count extraction.

Absent from the mounted tree: /vendor/bin/install-recovery.sh, /system/bin/move_widevine_data.sh, /system/bin/linkerconfig (the bootstrap/linkerconfig variant is present), /odm/etc/ueventd.rc. The .ko modules named in init.insmod.cfg and init.insmod.charger.cfg are not in the group.
The 2 symlink rows have no sha256 in the manifest; their targets were checked by readlink only.

The compiled SELinux policy (precompiled_sepolicy in odm_a) was not decoded; SELinux evidence comes from source-form file_contexts, property_contexts and CIL. Labels for the rc files and build.prop files inherit from directory-level rules that were not examined.

Which duplicate service definition is active at runtime (for example, the four zygote variants, or surfaceflinger and health-hal-2-1 in two files) depends on ro.zygote and ro.hardware values and on the import order; only the zygote selection logic was checked.
The property semantics (what each build.prop key does at run time) were not checked; the roles describe grouping and content only.
Working files are in <tools>/work/subsystems/init-and-properties: input_rows.tsv, role_map.txt, rc_summary.txt, rc_cmds.txt, service_index.tsv, init_strings.txt, keys_*.txt.
